Definition: neuter of a compound of G473 and G5179; corresponding ("antitype"), i.e. a representative, counterpart:--(like) figure (whereunto).
BiblicalUsage: The antitype is the figure that answers to the type, the reality that matches the shadow. Peter says baptism is the antitype of Noah's ark, the water that saved eight souls, and Hebrews says the earthly tabernacle is the figure of the true, into which Christ entered. The word joins the shadow to the substance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the types were never meant to stand alone: the ark pointed to baptism, and the tabernacle pointed to heaven itself. The shadow is real because the substance is real, and I hold that every figure in the old covenant finds its answer in Christ.
